items.summary: Only the core point-cloud/geometry slice (utility/camera/knn/geometry, CUPOCH_CORE_ONLY=ON) is built/validated on ROCm. Deferred GPU modules: registration (ICP/GICP/Colored/FGR/FilterReg), odometry, integration (TSDF/KinectFusion), collision, planning, kinfu, imageproc (libSGM stereo), io-beyond-geometry, visualization, Python module. Causes: (a) visualization/imageproc/io/pybind need OpenGL/GLEW/GLFW + libSGM + urdfdom host stack; (b) four geometry-factory .cu have strict-clang blockers re-enablable without OpenGL.
cupoch imageproc (libSGM stereo) HIP port: imageproc wraps CUDA-only libSGM (warp-intrinsic kernels); skipped on HIP automatically; needs a libSGM->HIP port first

cupoch ScalableTSDFVolume HIP redesign: device stdgpu::unordered_map stores 80KB VolumeUnit by value; emplace needs ~164KB stack frame past AMDGPU ~128KB scratch limit; needs upstream out-of-line voxel-block redesign; UniformTSDFVolume works

Rescan with the fixed scan_nvidia: third_party/flann/util/cutil_math.h carries the pre-2017 CUDA samples EULA-pointer notice. The port replaced it with a HIP shim on the AMD path but the vendored copy remains; no licence ruling recorded; needs a person's confirmation.
